blocks.text: Managing high volume support requests in Slack

Technical support specialists often feel overwhelmed by the constant pinging of notifications. To stay effective, you must control the noise. Start by opening your preferences with Command + Comma. Go to the Notifications tab and set your schedule to match your actual work hours. This stops the app from buzzing during your personal time.

Use the Unreads view to triage your day. Instead of clicking every channel, press Command + Shift + A to see all unread messages in one place. This helps you prioritize critical technical issues over casual team chatter. If a channel is too noisy, right click the channel name and select Mute. You can still check it when you have a clear head.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for Mac

Your hands should rarely leave the keyboard. The most important shortcut for a support specialist is Command + K. This opens the Quick Switcher. Type a few letters of a channel or person to jump there immediately. It is much faster than using your mouse to scroll through the sidebar.

items: Command + /: Opens the full list of keyboard shortcuts.
Command + F: Searches the current channel for keywords.
Shift + Enter: Adds a line break to your message without sending it.
Command + B: Bolds your text to highlight important instructions for users.
Command + I: Italicizes text for emphasis.

blocks.text: Technical support often involves repeating the same answers. Use search modifiers to find previous solutions. Type from:username to find messages sent by a specific engineer. Use in:channelname to narrow your search to a specific team. Combine these with has:link or has:file to find those tricky configuration guides you remember seeing last month.

When you solve a ticket in Slack, copy the resolution to your primary ticketing system. Do not let the information die in a chat thread. Use the Save for Later feature by hovering over a message and clicking the bookmark icon. This creates a temporary to-do list for your documentation tasks.

Sometimes the Slack app for Mac will stop responding or show blank screens. Before you reinstall, try the built-in fix. Go to the Help menu at the top of your screen. Select Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is often enough to fix minor performance issues. Ensure you are running at least macOS 14 to keep the app stable.

Technical support requires clear communication. If you find yourself typing the same troubleshooting steps, use a text expander or keep a local note file. You can also use Lazur to dictate your responses. Hold the function key and speak your technical notes. It will format them correctly at your cursor, saving you from repetitive typing strain.

faq.question: How do I find all my unread messages at once?
faq.answer: Press Command + Shift + A to open the Unreads view. This gathers all unread messages from channels and direct messages into one feed.

faq.question: Can I format my messages in Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. Use Command + B for bold and Command + I for italics. Use Shift + Enter to start a new line without sending the message.

faq.question: What should I do if Slack is slow on my Mac?
faq.answer: Go to the Help menu in the top menu bar, then choose Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This often resolves performance issues.
